purpose: Allow the trusted PA1 resource controller to release only exact observer slots it opened and closed, with physical cleanup proof.

transport.peer_authentication: Unix peer UID; ordinary observer-close additionally requires the opening peer PID and process start identity. PA1 resolves the current receiver through observer-status before it forwards a stored receipt.
transport.transfer: A later same-UID controller process may use the opaque capability read from the same private JobService database only after observer-status validates the current receiver source, runtime, supervisor PID/start, and daemon epoch. The daemon then checks the current daemon epoch, one-time capability digest, and exact idle physical slot identity; the stored prior process identity alone grants nothing.

capability.minted: Only after a successful owner-matched observer-close leaves that exact slot idle.
capability.server_storage: Capability SHA-256 and exact slot fingerprint in a bounded in-memory ledger for the current daemon epoch.
capability.controller_storage: Raw capability and fingerprint receipt in pa1_owned_resource_sessions beside the caller's private JobService database.
invalidation: observer-analyze or observer-turn internal resource access

success_requires: owned llama-server PID absent from a fresh process observation
GPU memory at or below the captured baseline tolerance
HostCoordinator protected residency lease release returned successfully
proof.cleanup: Reuse of Backend._evict_slot and its HostCoordinator residency-quiescence record.
proof.active_turn: A live JobService session without a close receipt remains pending; no process is terminated. Cleanup failures remain pending and can be reconciled with the same request ID.
proof.stale_capability: Returns stale/pending reconciliation; never represents physical release. The controller filters old-epoch receipts and continues bounded chunks so a stale historical target does not prevent cleanup of current exact targets; any stale target keeps the overall intent pending.

durability.intent: PowerPolicy release intent and rewarm veto are committed before the owner callback.
durability.session_metadata: ResourceController records trusted open and close transitions in the same JobService SQLite database.
durability.callback: Runs after the release-intent transaction commits and with no JobService transaction held. A completed ResourceController result requires per-session PID, memory, and host-release proof.
durability.daemon_restart: The in-memory capability ledger is lost. Durable controller intent remains pending; prior process-owner recovery and idle TTL retain their existing responsibilities.
